summary_en: Properst authorized acquisition of up to 500,000 shares (1.51% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥100 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 14 to November 30, 2026, to enable flexible capital policy execution.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Properst's board of directors resolved on October 13, 2026, to authorize the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 165, Paragraph 3). The company will acquire up to 500,000 shares of its ordinary stock, representing 1.51% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum total consideration of ¥100 million. Purchases will be executed through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 14 and November 30, 2026.

The stated purpose is to enable flexible execution of capital policy in response to changes in the business environment. As of September 30, 2026, the company had issued 35,147,915 shares with treasury holdings of 2,011,760 shares, leaving 33,136,155 shares in circulation.
